newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares losses as Brazil steadies.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares losses as Brazil steadies.

text.p: The Mexican peso had trimmed early softness by mid-morning Wednesday as concern over fallout from volatile Brazilian markets diminished, dealers said.
"Dealers are still somewhat cautious, but domestic and international markets are buoyant and have granted the peso a breather after a hectic day yesterday," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart both stood 0.4 of a centavo weaker at 7.9260/7.9290 and 7.9230/7.9260 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed 4.5 centavos weaker at 7.9220/7.9250 per dollar, after lining up with other contracts.
